description: Create developer-app inference requests (AI Exchange D8): POST /v1/chat/completions, POST /v1/messages, GET /v1/models and GET /v1/models/:id. The public capability a developer app calls AI with; its token's project_id scopes quota and spend, exactly as ai.app.run's does. ai.run.create stays first-party for workflows and runs and is never grantable to a developer app. With AI_MODEL_CATALOG on, the response carries the `openvibe` disclosure and `model` may be an exact id or a dynamic alias (CHECKPOINT D3).
